Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit Image 1, the existing Chinese showerhead advertisement D06. Preserve its existing portrait aspect ratio, exact Chinese header "近看出水的起点", the three blue pills "常规出水" "喷雾出水" "混合出水", the large upper nozzle/water closeup, the white divider, and cool blue water background. This is a geometry correction specifically to the SMALL LOWER HORIZONTAL PRODUCT.

Input roles: Image 1 is only the edit target and layout; its existing lower product silhouette is WRONG. Image 2 is four UNEDITED REAL VIDEO FRAMES of the SAME physical product in black: front, side A, back, side B; this is the authoritative SHAPE reference. Image 3 is an actual SILVER photo, authoritative chrome finish and confirmation of side geometry; ignore its attached hose/connector because those are not sold. Image 4 A013 is the style reference ONLY for the low-angle horizontal product over blue water. Image 5 R007 is ONLY the style reference for close visible water origins; do not copy its rectangular product or text.

Replace the entire lower product body outline with the actual smooth curved body from the SECOND column of Image 2, rigidly rotated clockwise about 90 degrees: grip continues out of the LEFT frame, head toward RIGHT, nozzle face points DOWN. Reproduce that real extended, shallow camber accurately in silver chrome. Its head back is gently convex and flows continuously into the broad neck and gently curved grip; the thickness changes gradually. REMOVE the existing small raised platform/step at the head root and the abrupt undercut scoop immediately below it. This is one continuous molded body, without a separate round disk stuck on a stem, without a bulb or a short deep gooseneck, without exaggerating an S. Do not straighten it into a flat paddle. Preserve the real broad round head, black face with dense ordinary white round ports, outer fine black perforations, small central raised RED RING with a dark center hole, and the single small silver mode button on the face-side neck. The mode button is the only legitimate local protrusion; don't mistake it for a body joint.

In the lower panel normal water is emitted evenly across ALL visible effective white ports, rooted at their openings, with clear continuous jets downward toward the water surface, as in Image 1. No visible dry half. No water emitted through the chrome sidewall, red ring, or random added ports. No nozzle redesign. No hose, quick connector, bracket, logo, specs, numbers, new text, inset, or geometry guides. Keep the large upper panel and typography visually as they are. Photorealistic detailed product, faithful observed silhouette rather than another generic showerhead. Output the complete corrected advertisement.
